summary: Static Astro site on Cloudflare (Workers static assets / Pages) (global CDN) with no backend or database. Estimated $5-100/month (around the $50 budget).

architecture_rationale.text: Pre-rendered pages served from a CDN with no server tier: nothing to patch or scale for a read-only site.

frontend.justification: Web - Astro: Chosen because team already works in javascript (team.languages); static-first output for a content_site (scale.workload=read_heavy); server-rendered/pre-rendered HTML for seo_critical=true; strong cost efficiency (5/5) with priorities.cost=4.

alternatives.why_not: Astro scores higher on maintainability and learning curve (fit 11.0 vs 11.1).
Astro scores higher on maintainability (fit 10.9 vs 11.1).

tradeoffs: App-like interactivity needs islands/hydration per component
Smaller ecosystem than React meta-frameworks for complex apps

backend.justification: No dynamic requirement: project.type=content_site, auth=none, payments/realtime/uploads/ML all false, workload=read_heavy. Pages are generated at build time, so there is no server to run.

alternatives.why_not: nothing to execute per request; would add cost and attack surface for no benefit

tradeoffs: Add a server tier later only if dynamic features (forms, auth, comments) appear

database.justification: No persistent application data: content is authored as files in the repository and compiled at build time (Markdown, per project.description)

alternatives.why_not: adds a moving part and cost for content a single author edits as files

tradeoffs: Add a server tier later only if dynamic features (forms, auth, comments) appear

hosting.justification: Chosen because serves pre-built static files from a global CDN; strong scalability (5/5) with priorities.scalability=5; strong cost efficiency (5/5) with priorities.cost=4; strong performance (5/5) with priorities.performance=3.

alternatives.why_not: Cloudflare scores higher on scalability and cost (fit 8.1 vs 9.3).
Amazon S3 + CloudFront starts around $40/month against a $50/month total budget. Cloudflare scores higher on learning curve and time-to-market (fit 7.1 vs 9.3).
Excluded by hard constraint: deployment_model=managed_cloud is not on-premise.

tradeoffs: Cloudflare now steers new projects from Pages to Workers static assets

supporting.justification: Chosen because the hosting platform already serves through a global CDN; strong scalability (5/5) with priorities.scalability=5; strong cost efficiency (5/5) with priorities.cost=4; strong performance (5/5) with priorities.performance=3.

alternatives.why_not: Cloudflare CDN (free/pro plan) starts around $25/month against a $50/month total budget. Built-in CDN of Cloudflare scores higher on integration with the hosting platform (fit 6.0 vs 8.5).
Amazon CloudFront starts around $50/month against a $50/month total budget. Built-in CDN of Cloudflare scores higher on integration with the hosting platform and time-to-market (fit 1.2 vs 8.5).

supporting.justification: Chosen because Git push deploys with previews are built into the hosting; strong cost efficiency (5/5) with priorities.cost=4; strong time-to-market (5/5) with priorities.time_to_market=3; strong scalability (4/5) with priorities.scalability=5.

alternatives.why_not: GitHub Actions starts around $40/month against a $50/month total budget. Git-push deploys on Cloudflare scores higher on integration with the hosting platform (fit 2.4 vs 6.1).
Azure Pipelines starts around $60/month against a $50/month total budget. Git-push deploys on Cloudflare scores higher on integration with the hosting platform and cost (fit 0.2 vs 6.1).

supporting.justification: Chosen because static site: platform analytics are enough; strong cost efficiency (5/5) with priorities.cost=4; strong time-to-market (5/5) with priorities.time_to_market=3; fully managed: no operations work for a team without DevOps.

alternatives.why_not: Sentry (errors + performance) starts around $80/month against a $50/month total budget. Cloudflare analytics/logs scores higher on fit for the project type and cost (fit 0.4 vs 5.0).

Prometheus + Grafana + Loki (self-hosted) starts around $150/month against a $50/month total budget; needs ongoing operations work but team.has_devops=false (ops burden 3/5). Cloudflare analytics/logs scores higher on fit for the project type (fit -2.0 vs 5.0).

assumptions: Order-of-magnitude band from approximate public list prices (USD) in the knowledge base; not a quote
Sized for 2,000,000 users at 12 months, 40,000 peak concurrent users, ~4,000 req/s peak (scale tier: large)
Data: ~2 GB in the database, ~0 GB of media, ~9,766 GB/month egress
Excludes taxes, developer salaries, domain names, app-store fees and one-off migration work

breakdown.basis: large tier (~4,000 req/s peak, 40,000 concurrent users)

warnings.message: Expected $5-100/month: the upper end exceeds the $50 budget at peak usage. Set billing alerts.
